description: DefaultStrings:472 and :473 -- the LIBRARY'S OWN default failure handler and fallback policy, which the oracle's recording wrappers displaced in every other fixture. Neither is installed here, so the constructor selects TranslationFailureHandler.returnKey() and fallbackOnMissingTranslationOrNoMatchingAlternative() itself and the probe observes what they do. The instance locale is 'de' and the fallback 'en' so the default POLICY has something to decide.
